T-001.Title: Add the deterministic generator, regenerate the committed classic artifact and prove --check freshness

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Add tools/generate-clipboard-capture.mjs as a Node ESM script with zero new dependencies: it reads tools/clipboard-capture/capture-core.js, normalizes the source line endings to LF in memory only (the canonical file is never rewritten by the generator), transforms the normalized source with the transformWithEsbuild export of the installed Vite under the fixed option set loader js, format iife, globalName __ClipboardCaptureCoreModule, target es2020, sourcemap false, minify false, and wraps the transformed code with the static classic wrapper exactly as specified in the implementation notes: an authored prologue carrying the FILE/VERSION header, the GENERATED provenance notice (repository-relative literals, no timestamps, no machine or absolute paths, no source maps) and the file-local START_MODULE_CONTRACT/END_MODULE_CONTRACT plus START_MODULE_MAP/END_MODULE_MAP blocks, and an authored epilogue IIFE that projects exactly the five public functions onto globalThis.ClipboardCaptureCore in the former order through explicit key literals — no spread or whole-module assignment that could expose the other ESM exports as new public keys, no Node globals, and no normalization/payload/metadata/filename/issue logic duplicated in the wrapper. Output is written LF-only; generation is a pure function of source bytes plus the pinned toolchain, with no eval, no runtime module import/export in the artifact and no external resources.

Modes fail closed: no arguments and --check are the read-only freshness check that recomputes the expected bytes, compares them byte-for-byte against tools/clipboard-capture/capture-core.browser.js and exits non-zero naming the artifact and the reason (missing, stale against current source, or manually edited) without writing anything; --write generates first and only then writes the one known generated artifact; unknown flags exit non-zero with usage. The main routine runs only under the invoked-as-script guard so vitest can import the pure helpers (renderBrowserCore over an inert source string, and the byte-compare) without triggering reads that fail or writes; helpers never edit tracked canonical/generated files to simulate drift.

Run node tools/generate-clipboard-capture.mjs --write once and commit the regenerated tools/clipboard-capture/capture-core.browser.js: its file-local GRACE contract/map markup stays present, its five-key globalThis.ClipboardCaptureCore stays in the former order, and no capture algorithm, schema/version value, MIME ordering, record/history key, filename, issue packet/URL content, truncation, UUID/random/time/platform fallback or exception behavior changes anywhere. tools/clipboard-capture/index.html, app.js and styles.css stay byte-identical. Update tools/clipboard-capture/README.md only with the generated-artifact provenance and the two maintenance commands (node tools/generate-clipboard-capture.mjs --check / --write), preserving the existing capture-scope statements including the OS-native/binary non-capture boundary.
